title: perf: every PR push starts ~15 jobs, each with its own checkout, mostly for guards a diff cannot fail
problem: A PR head triggers a median of 10 workflows and 15 jobs. Many are cheap guards with overlapping triggers, each paying runner start-up and a checkout, and some run on diffs that cannot affect them. Jobs that should run on a change sometimes do not: PR #10185 merged a post whose description broke every Pages build on main, which suggests the trigger map is wide where it is cheap to be narrow and narrow where it matters.
evidence: ci_profile.py saved payload, 2026-10-24 (45 PR heads, 600 runs): jobs per PR head median 15 (mean 14.6), workflows per head median 10
45 jobs in the same window ran with every work step skipped (12.3 job-minutes), e.g. Duplicate symbols 7, Prompts validate 6, Portfolio Pages site build 7
main red 2026-10-24 after PR #10185 (docs/posts description 238 chars > 160): writing.mjs loadPosts throws, failing build.mjs and every buildSite test
change: Fold the cheap guards that share a trigger into one 'guards' workflow with one checkout and one step per guard (keep each guard's script and failure message; check branch protection's required names first). Give each remaining workflow a paths filter that matches what its script reads, and add the validator that every docs/posts or Pages-input change runs writing.test.mjs. Measure jobs per PR head before and after.
metric: jobs per PR head (median) and job-minutes per merged PR
baseline: median 15 jobs / 10 workflows per PR head, 2026-10-24
